description: This source file implements the XBSStore class, which manages bootstrap configuration data, including reading/writing configuration files, monitoring partner ID changes via inotify, and handling device-specific defaults. It also includes functions for creating necessary files/directories and managing internal state related to bootstrap parameters.

classes.name: XBSStore
classes.description: Manages bootstrap configuration data, including reading/writing config files, monitoring partner ID changes, and handling device-specific defaults.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for XBSStore instance, starts partner ID monitoring thread if not already started.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the partner ID monitoring thread.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a bootstrap parameter.

methods.name: overrideValue
methods.description: Overrides a bootstrap parameter value, handling special cases for clearing DB and partner ID changes.

methods.name: loadFromJson
methods.description: Loads bootstrap configuration from JSON files based on partner ID.

methods.name: loadBSPropertiesIntoCache
methods.description: Loads bootstrap properties from the properties file into internal cache.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the bootstrap store, loading properties and configuration.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Returns the raw value of a bootstrap parameter from internal cache.

methods.name: setRawValue
methods.description: Sets a bootstrap parameter value, updating files and internal cache.

methods.name: clearRfcValues
methods.description: Clears RFC-related bootstrap values, resetting to defaults.

methods.name: initBSPropertiesFileName
methods.description: Reads bootstrap properties filename from configuration file.
